Chapter 564 - 564 Mission Completed; Good Luck?! (1)

564 Mission Completed; Good Luck?! (1)

Li Family Cuisine was a well-known luxurious restaurant in Modu. Whether it was the dishes, the decor, or the style, they were all far superior to ordinary restaurants.

Therefore, there were many guests every day.

After Qin Yuxuan announced her name, the waiter quickly brought the three of them to a luxurious private room on the third floor.

It was luxurious and grand.

One could see the empty street outside when one looked up.

Even so, it still could not conceal the low atmosphere in the private room.

It was Qin Yuxuan who spoke first, making the atmosphere livelier.

“Ling Rou, you can try Jingbei smoked meat later. Don’t worry, it’s not greasy at all! There’s also shark fin, and the sauce that comes with it is super delicious…”

After listening to Qin Yuxuan’s description, Ling Rou swallowed her saliva as if she had already seen these delicacies.

Soon, delicious dishes were served.

Qin Yuxuan directly picked up a piece of Jingbei smoked meat and placed it into Qin Yuxuan’s bowl. She said, “Ling Rou, try it quickly.”

“Alright,” Ling Rou replied.

The smoked meat melted in her mouth. It was very soft and fragrant.

“It’s delicious!” Ling Rou praised sincerely.

“Right?” Qin Yuxuan smiled and said, “Try this…”

The atmosphere in the private room became more and more lively as the delicacies entered their stomachs.

The two women started chatting and laughing again.

Lin Fan was the only one who had been left hanging.

Lin Fan was very happy about this.

He did not want to see them battle it out.

…

The meal lasted until eight o’clock in the evening.

Everyone’s stomachs were bulging.

At this moment, Qin Yuxuan said, “Ling Rou, let’s go to my house.”

Before Ling Rou could reply, she held her hand and walked back.

In the living room that was nearly 100 square meters, one could see the extremely spacious balcony, the bright French windows, and the rolling river view in the distance.

It was as if one were standing between heaven and earth. It was immense enjoyment.

“Ling Rou, why are you standing there?” Qin Yuxuan asked with a smile. “Sit down.”

“Ah… Alright,” Ling Rou replied.

“What do you want to drink?” Qin Yuxuan asked.

“Anything’s fine as long as it’s chilled,” Ling Rou said.

“Alright.”

The three of them sat on the sofa and were silent for a moment. The atmosphere at the scene became dull again.

Ling Rou kept scratching her fingers.

Lin Fan looked at the sky and the ground as if there was something interesting going on.

Only Qin Yuxuan had a smile on her face.

Finally, Qin Yuxuan smiled and said, “I have a rough idea of Ling Rou’s situation. Lin Fan, do you have anything else to add to our sister’s story?”

The air…

At that moment, it seemed to have frozen.

Sister…?

Qin Yuxuan knew.

In fact…

When Ling Rou appeared at the company, Lin Fan had already expected this to happen.

However, when it really happened, his heart could not help but beat faster.

After a while, Lin Fan said awkwardly, “This… Actually… I was the one who wrote the lyrics and composition for Galaxy.”

Qin Yuxuan seemed to have expected this and was not too surprised. She nodded and said, “No wonder it sounds so good.”

“Ling Rou’s concert was also arranged by me.”

“Mhm, no wonder it’s so grand.”

“After that, I even accompanied her to the Golden Melody Awards.”

“This kind of grand prize is deserved.”

After Qin Yuxuan finished speaking, she held onto Ling Rou’s slender hand once more. At the same time, she also held onto Lin Fan’s hand.

Then, the three hands were placed together.

“Actually, I already knew… Where are my other sisters? When can we meet?”

“I’ll call them now,” Lin Fan said. As he spoke, he took out his phone.

“Silly girl, why are you calling them?” Qin Yuxuan asked. “Most of them are from Jiangbei, right?”

“If I want to see them, I’ll find an opportunity to do so. I’ll go to Jiangbei to see them.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright.”

Then, Qin Yuxuan looked at Ling Rou and said with a smile, “Ling Rou, we’ll be good sisters from now on.”

“Yes, yes!” Ling Rou nodded vigorously.

Perhaps it was because the window was not open.

The air in the living room began to heat up.

The dark clouds covered the sky, and the heavy rain hit the floor-to-ceiling windows, but it did not have much effect.

…

For the next few days, Lin Fan accompanied Qin Yuxuan and Ling Rou, either shopping or going to the amusement park. It was very enjoyable.

However, happy days were always very short.

After rejecting several jobs, Ling Rou was finally forced to go back to work.

Qin Yuxuan also had many things to deal with.

Therefore, Lin Fan stayed in Modu for four days before returning to Jiangbei.

Lin Fan sat on the soft sofa and casually scrolled through his phone for a while. He realized that his popularity was still high.

Therefore, he temporarily gave up on his plan to go to school tomorrow.

In the blink of an eye, another four days passed.

It was Friday.

The setting sun in the distance dyed the sky red, making it bright and brilliant.

Lin Fan drove Lin Xiaoyao in his Cullinan on the straight highway toward Qing City.

When they were at home, they did not think much of it.

However, once they were far away, they would miss it dearly.

Lin Xiaoyao was like that even though she had just gone to Swede with her parents not long ago.

Lin Fan and Lin Xiaoyao arrived at Qing City before the sun set.
